notes: This contract records one bounded public C++ RTI exception-name check. The portable TCK constructs an RTIambassador and invokes getObjectClassHandle before Connect, catches the API-declared NotConnected exception through the public Exception base, and checks that Exception::name() returns the exact name string NotConnected. This does not establish every exception's name string, exception precedence, all programming-language mappings, or conformance; it is provider-specific test evidence for the explicitly exercised case only.
